## Known biases

Only used to choose dry days for the 311 baseline (F5, late calls). Three point gauges 6.2 to 15.9 km from the square&\#x27;s edge: rain that fell only on the square would be missed. NCEI&\#x27;s own use limitation: the stations were not managed for climate monitoring and the data are not homogenized. Which hours a day covers at these stations was not found in the readme (not checked).
